content: .{@-व्रत, -संगर, -संध@} {%a.%} .²1 true or faithful to an agreement, promise or word, adhering to truth, veracious; <ls>Bhāg. 10. 2. 26</ls>; see सत्यः (4). .²2 honest, sincere.

.{@-संधः@} .²1 an epithet of Rāma; राजेन्द्रं सत्यसंधं दशरथतनयम् <ls>Rāmarakṣā 26</ls>. .²2 of Bharata. .²3 of king Janamejaya. . ({@-धा@}) an epithet of Draupadī. --{%a.%} keeping oneʼs promise, faithful.
